audit_area: Audit A — Idempotency Retention and Replay Analysis

retention_policy.pruning_algorithm: FIFO sort by ISO timestamp, retaining the newest 1,000 entries (dict(sorted_keys[-1000:]))
retention_policy.persistence: Persisted in state JSON under _processed_idempotency_keys key

replay_vulnerability_analysis.root_cause: reserve_order_slot() only validates if clean_key in self._processed_idempotency_keys. It does not query historical closed_trades or a permanent tombstone ledger.
replay_vulnerability_analysis.test_evidence: test_audit_a_pruned_key_replay_vulnerability verified that after injecting and committing 1,005 subsequent trades, KEY_TARGET was pruned from _processed_idempotency_keys. A subsequent open_simulated_trade() with KEY_TARGET was accepted and executed successfully.
replay_vulnerability_analysis.temporal_risk_window: Vulnerable to replay once 1,000 subsequent orders are committed and the current position is flat.
replay_vulnerability_analysis.severity: MEDIUM (Paper environment limit; orders still restricted to 1 lot and single concurrent position, but violates strict permanent idempotency invariant)

recommendations.implementation: Check any(t.get('idempotency_key') == clean_key for t in self.closed_trades) or keep an unbounded lightweight set of SHA-256 hashes of all processed idempotency keys.
Maintain an append-only JSONL or SQLite database of historical idempotency tokens that is never pruned.
